name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
